license_source: https://huggingface.co/Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-ROMANCE-en/raw/e9ca9975e3972afd80732f08ce01d3a1339f47f8/README.md (model card front matter license: apache-2.0; no LICENSE file in the repository)
notes: MarianMT (6+6 layers, d_model 512, shared 65,001-piece vocabulary, about 75M parameters) translating Romance languages, Romanian included, into English. The main revision publishes only pytorch_model.bin; training/python/download_model.py converts it to safetensors (weights_only load) and records both digests. The sinusoidal (static) position table is extended from 512 to max_position_embeddings; the first 512 rows are identical to the original.
